# Hasb-e-Rabbi Travels & Tours

## About
Hasb-e-Rabbi Travels & Tours is a Ministry of Religious Affairs approved Hajj and Umrah travel agency based in Pakistan. Established in 2013, we have served over 8,450 pilgrims with 100% visa approval guarantee. Our registration number is MRA/423.

## Services

### Umrah Packages
We offer three tiers of Umrah packages for Pakistani pilgrims:
- Economy Umrah Package: PKR 185,000 per person (10 days, 3-star hotel, 600m from Haram)
- Premium Umrah Package: PKR 295,000 per person (15 days, 4-star hotel, 100m from Haram)
- Executive VIP Package: PKR 450,000 per person (14-21 days, 5-star Clock Tower hotels with Haram view)

All packages include visa processing, air tickets, hotel accommodation, AC transport, meals, Ziyarat tours, and experienced Muallim guidance.

### Hajj Packages
We offer Hajj packages for Pakistani pilgrims with full support including visa, accommodation in Makkah and Madinah, transport, meals, and experienced guides. Contact us for current Hajj 2026 availability.

### Visa Services
We provide visa consultation and assistance for Pakistani passport holders for the following countries:
- Saudi Arabia (Tourist, Business, Umrah, Work Visa)
- UAE / Dubai (Tourist 30/60 days, Visit, Work Visa)
- United Kingdom (Visitor, Student, Work, Family Visa)
- Schengen Europe (Tourist, Business, Transit Visa)
- Malaysia (eVisa, Single Entry, Social Visit Visa)
- Turkey (e-Visa, Sticker Tourist Visa)
- Canada (Visitor TRV, Student, Work Permit, PR)
- Australia (Tourist Subclass 600, Student, Work, Business Visa)

## Frequently Asked Questions
- What is the price of Umrah package from Pakistan? Economy starts at PKR 185,000, Premium at PKR 295,000, VIP at PKR 450,000.
- How long does Umrah visa take? Through Hasb-e-Rabbi, Umrah visa is processed in 7-10 working days.
- Is Hasb-e-Rabbi Ministry approved? Yes, registration number MRA/423, approved since 2013.
- Do you offer Hajj packages? Yes, contact us for Hajj 2026 availability and pricing.
- Which cities do you serve? Karachi, Lahore, Islamabad, Rawalpindi, Peshawar, Quetta, Multan, Faisalabad and all across Pakistan.
- What documents are needed for Umrah? Valid passport (6 months), CNIC copy, 2 passport size photos, and Mahram certificate for women.
